title_sq: Prane Casa Italia, Tek kompleksi Tirana New Entry, Me 1250 Euro\m2 Shitet Super Apartament 2+1+2 Me Planimetri Te Rregullt !!!

title_en: Near Casa Italia, in the Tirana New Entry complex, for sale 1250 Euro\m2 Super Apartment 2+1+2 With Regular Layout!!!

Sustainability and longevity in design.
